instruction: How many songs from across my spotify song and album libraries were released in this year?

steps.code:
from datetime import datetime
current_date = datetime.now()
current_year = current_date.year
print(current_date, current_year)

spotify_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "spotify")
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username="bradley_ball@gmail.com", password=spotify_password)
print(login_result)

song_library = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    song_library.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(song_library))
print(song_library[:2])
